provenance: Existing original deterministic513x259 benchmark controls, reused without changing image content, source sampling/quality or normalized reference settings. WarmJpegRgbInput.Build changes only component identifiers/Adobe metadata; entropy/quantizers remain unchanged. No upstream corpus image is included.
authoring: benchmarks/Lokad.Image.Benchmarks/WarmJpegRgbInput.cs; original raster from tools/Shared/OriginalPixels.cs and the established background flattening recipe.
reference: Pinned FFmpeg n8.1; exact normalized RGB. GRAY8 is full-range BT.601 conversion of those normalized8-bit components, using the already qualified Q15/Q14 precision. Normal/scalar and Windows/Linux agree.
